title: Local Legends
summary: A football platform that connects local players, teams and organizers through match discovery, event management and social engagement. It simplifies coordination and makes local football easier to join.
shortSummary: A community platform connecting local football players, teams and organizers through match discovery, event management and social engagement.

title: Rever Life ERP
tagline: Full-stack ERP for a wellness distributor business.
summary: A full-stack ERP for a wellness and distributor-based business, covering inventory, orders, payments, ledger management and user administration. The build included a scalable backend architecture, authentication, cloud deployment and cost-optimized infrastructure.
shortSummary: A full-stack ERP for a wellness distributor, covering inventory, orders, payments, ledgers and user management, deployed on cost-optimized cloud infrastructure.
highlights: Built for a multi-level distribution business: inventory, order processing, distributor management and ledger workflows.
Backend of 20+ modular APIs and 15+ tables, with email and phone OTP sign-in, role-based access and audit trails.
Admin dashboards for the team and a separate portal for distributors.
Deployed on a Linux VPS with Docker and Nginx. Media moved to Amazon S3 to avoid disk and memory exhaustion during concurrent uploads.
Worked with the client through requirements, demos and testing.

title: FrontWave
tagline: Research publishing platform for an equity researcher.
summary: A website and subscriber platform for FrontWave, a SEBI-registered equity research firm in Mumbai. Visitors read the firm's public pages and the research it publishes openly. Members sign in to the Terminal to read full reports and momentum calls, and pay for a plan online. The research team drafts, reviews and publishes everything from their own portal, with no developer involved.
highlights: Three parts: the public site, the Terminal for members, and a team portal for staff.
Research is written, reviewed and published in the team portal, with analyst and admin roles and an approval step before anything goes live.
Members-only research is gated on the server, not just hidden in the page.
Members sign in with an emailed link or Google, and pay for plans online with GST invoices generated for them.
Every sensitive action is recorded in an audit log.

title: AS Metals
tagline: Corporate website for a steel and scrap processor in Sharjah, UAE.
summary: A corporate website for Al Saham Al Fadhi Metal Industries LLC, a steel and scrap processor in Sharjah, UAE. It presents the company, its processing lines and a product catalogue, and gives buyers sourcing and cut-to-length tools plus a way to send enquiries and quote requests. It is exported as plain static files, so it needs no server to run.
linkNote: This is a demo link. The live site will be deployed soon.
highlights: 21 prerendered routes: 10 pages and 11 generated product pages, exported as static files.
Interactive tools: a sea-lane sourcing map of scrap routes and shipments, a cut-to-length line comparison and a filterable product catalogue.
All copy and product data live in typed content modules, so a mistyped field fails the build instead of rendering blank.
Full-screen sections with scroll-snap that scale type and spacing with both screen width and height, so they fit short laptop screens, and respect reduced-motion settings.
Generated sitemap and robots.txt, canonical and Open Graph metadata, and a contact form that falls back to the visitor's email app when no form endpoint is set.

title: Co-Daftar
summary: Co-Daftar is a premium coworking space in Raipur for entrepreneurs, freelancers, startups and professionals. It has modern workspaces, meeting rooms, high-speed internet and a member community.
shortSummary: A premium coworking space in Raipur with modern workspaces, meeting rooms, high-speed internet and a community for entrepreneurs and teams.

title: Plinth Scout
tagline: Low-cost rotating LiDAR scanner for architects and engineers.
summary: A long-term hardware concept: a low-cost rotating LiDAR scanner that generates point clouds, floor plans, and DXF exports for architects and engineers.

title: E-CRF
tagline: Electronic case report forms for clinical research.
summary: An electronic case report form (eCRF) system that replaces paper forms for collecting clinical and research data in a structured, checkable way. It started as a demo for a client; that project didn't go ahead, and the system is still in development.

title: Munshi
tagline: AI assistant for business email and WhatsApp.
summary: An AI assistant that reads business email and WhatsApp messages about invoices and other business information, picks out what matters, and helps draft, send and analyse emails.

title: Bank Customer Segmentation
tagline: Clustering bank customers by how they transact.
summary: Groups a bank's customers into segments based on their transactions using clustering, with a written walkthrough and 8 charts.

title: CarDekho Used Car Prices
tagline: Exploring and predicting used car prices.
summary: Explores used car listings from CarDekho and builds a model that predicts a car's price, with a written walkthrough and 8 charts.

title: JustWatch Scraper
tagline: Collecting movie and TV data from a live website.
summary: A web scraper that collects movie and TV show details from JustWatch (title, year, genre, IMDb rating and the streaming services each is on) by reading the pages directly, not through an API. The data is then filtered to recent, highly rated titles and analysed to find the top genres and the streaming service with the most offerings, with the results saved to CSV. It runs as a notebook or as a script.
